# Leben in Deutschland

## Overview
This site provides a free, ad-free resource for learners preparing for the German citizenship exam and the Leben in Deutschland test.

## Key pages
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/full-page-experience/
- https://lebenindeutschland2027.de/clip/

## Topics covered
- Free Leben in Deutschland practice
- German citizenship exam preparation
- No ads and no paywall study app
- App Clip entry point for compatible iPhone devices

## Important note
The project is intended to be free to use and free from advertising interruptions for learners.
